# NQTCoder

NQTCoder is a platform designed to help students prepare for national recruitment coding tests (like TCS NQT, etc.). It replicates actual recruitment coding environments with a proctored test environment and compiler support for C++, Java, and Python.

## Core Features
- [Practice Arena](https://nqtcoder.vercel.app/practice): Solve programming questions.
- [Mock Tests](https://nqtcoder.vercel.app/mocktest): Practice real proctored mock exams.
- [Student Rankings](https://nqtcoder.vercel.app/leaderboard): View top rankers.
- [Compiler Setup Guide](https://nqtcoder.vercel.app/compiler-setup): Detailed local and cloud compiler instructions.
- [About Platform](https://nqtcoder.vercel.app/about): Information about the platform support and direct contacts.
